about: Ask for review of a content decision or request withdrawal of your artifact
title: "[Content appeal] "

**Do not post private task text, credentials, personal data, or confidential rights documents in a public issue.** Use a listed private contact if one exists; otherwise, do not send sensitive details.

- Artifact ID, version, and prior decision/report link:
- Your role: contributor / rights holder / representative / other
- Request: appeal / withdrawal / corrected version / attribution correction
- Public evidence or explanation:
- For a corrected package, link the new version and its complete provenance/rights/license/NOTICE inventory:

Maintainers should record the request and outcome without deleting the old audit trail. A revised package receives a new version and review; an appeal does not reactivate a paused version automatically.
